evals.prompt: Use the reproducible-data-work skill to merge examples/customer-reconciliation/source/customers.csv and examples/customer-reconciliation/source/transactions.csv.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves and hashes both inputs, infers and documents the join grain, writes explicit ordered SQL, prevents row multiplication, produces a merged deliverable and visible unmatched-record exceptions, records domain-relevant checks and a provenance manifest, verifies reproducibility, and opens both deliverables in an installed spreadsheet application or an HTML review fallback without requiring the user to request those behaviors.
expectations: Both source files remain byte-identical and their SHA-256 hashes are recorded.
All data interpretation and transformation logic is preserved in ordered, readable SQL files.
The agent names its chosen output grain and join coverage, and the primary deliverable implements that interpretation without accidental row multiplication or data loss.
Unmatched transaction records are delivered as visible row-level exceptions even though the prompt did not request them.
A run manifest records the engine version, configuration, inputs, ordered steps, outputs, and domain-relevant reconciliation checks.
Replaying the workflow produces byte-identical primary and exception outputs.
The primary result and exception output are actually opened in an installed spreadsheet application, or an HTML review report is opened when no spreadsheet application exists.
